purpose: Reads a picture file once and makes upright copies no larger than the sizes you ask for: JPEG or WebP, a thumbnail, a screen copy and a full copy by default, never enlarged or cropped, with an optional host decoder for HEIC.
namedChanges: K1. the imports of pictures.ts (1-9) are not taken; PictureUnreadableError is local; decode and encodeJpeg stay unexported
S1. encodeJpeg calls encode(d, maxEdge, quality, type) with image/jpeg, so the 0.1.0 paths give the same output; webpSupported() probes a 1x1 canvas once and remembers the answer

S2. makePictureSet(file, options?) answers thumb (320, q0.72), screen (1600, q0.82) and full (4096, q0.9; null when the original's longest edge is at most screen) from one decode; type image/jpeg, image/webp or auto
S3. setHeicDecoder(fn | null) and HEIC_UNREADABLE: when the browser fails on a HEIC file the app's decoder is tried once; a HEIC failure now says HEIC, every other failure keeps the 0.1.0 message

library.title: Picture shrink / resize (thumbnail, WebP)
library.note: Makes smaller bytes only and sends nothing; to send them take picture-upload. It is not a cropper.
